[B. Acceptance intent]
Item	Intent
Target impression	Credible, premium, established professional consultancy.
Avoid	Generic SaaS/startup styling, novelty for novelty’s sake, excessive animation.
Prioritise	Services, evidence of experience and projects, trust, clear contact conversion, careers where appropriate.
Devices	Desktop and mobile both matter; mobile must feel designed rather than collapsed.
Sector character	Construction/property-sector character should be visible without becoming clichéd.
Design preference	Restrained modern design preferred over generic corporate template output.
Imagery	Imagery must be genuinely relevant and rights-safe.
Prohibited claims	No unsupported performance, client, award, accreditation or experience claims.
[B. Rights declaration]
Statement

research.title: nbm Construction Cost Consultants | Chartered Quantity Surveyors & Cost Consultants – Glasgow & Edinburgh | Building Surveyor Services
research.description: nbm are Scotland's Leading Quantity Surveyor and ranks as one of the largest QS practices in Scotland, with offices in Edinburgh and Glasgow. We offer expert Quantity Surveying, Cost Management, and Project Management services tailored to your needs.

research.title: Refurbishment of The Met Hotel Leeds | nbm Construction Cost Consultants
research.description: NBM provided Project Management and Quantity Surveying services on the major refurbishment of The Met Hotel Leeds, a 125-bedroom landmark hotel in the heart of the city centre. Originally opened in 1899, the project involved the transformation and repositioning of the hotel, combining the restoration of its historic character with new interiors, refreshed public areas, upgraded meeting and event facilities, and the introduction of Gott’s Bar & Kitchen.
